request.raw_text: Add two click buttons with the height of 2 millimetre to provide a comfortable and responsive feel for the user

areas_to_change.action: Create two distinct click-button features, each with a specified height of 2 mm.
areas_to_change.reference_geometry: Top shell surface and the existing centrally positioned scroll wheel assembly.
areas_to_change.location: On the front portion of the upper shell, with one button on each side of the longitudinal centerline and adjacent to the existing scroll wheel.
areas_to_change.description: Divide or modify the front-top control surface to form a left and right click button. Each button should rise 2 mm relative to its supporting top-shell surface and should remain separately operable.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Existing central scroll wheel and its mounting region
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Retain the wheel's position, orientation, clearance, and exposed shape while placing the new buttons around it.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Main lower body, side walls, rear housing, and overall ergonomic outer profile
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Keep the current body shape and dimensions unchanged except for local modifications required to create the two upper buttons.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Longitudinal symmetry and smooth exterior transitions
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Maintain a balanced left-right arrangement and avoid unintended sharp edges or discontinuities.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: The model will have two discrete 2 mm-high button features on the front upper surface, positioned to the left and right of the existing central scroll wheel.
predicted_final_outcome.function: The added features will serve as the primary left and right user-actuated click controls.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: Each button is expected to depress independently and return after release, providing a comfortable and responsive tactile click while maintaining clearance from the scroll wheel.

ambiguities.description: The exact button footprint, edge shape, spacing, and front-to-rear extent are not specified.
candidate_interpretations: Create two conventional broad mouse-button surfaces divided by a central seam.
Create two smaller raised button pads adjacent to the scroll wheel.

ambiguities.description: The datum and meaning of the specified 2 mm height are not defined.
candidate_interpretations: Make each button protrude 2 mm normal to the local top-shell surface.
Make each button body 2 mm thick.
Use 2 mm as the button actuation travel.

ambiguities.description: The request does not specify an actuation mechanism or required clearances.
candidate_interpretations: Model only the visible button geometry.
Add separate movable button bodies with perimeter gaps and space for an internal switch mechanism.
Integrate compliant button regions into the existing upper shell.
